_comment: Copy to var/signal-routes.json and chmod 600 — the relay refuses a
file anyone else can read, because this one holds broker tokens AND
the switch that turns a webhook into an order.
Nothing in this path consults the nine brains, the Regime Engine, the
Risk Engine or the Execution Gate. Enabling a route delegates the
decision to the TradingView strategy and to nothing else in this
repository. That is a legitimate thing to want; it is also the
largest reduction in safety this codebase has.
Every route must also have a matching endpoint with kind:"strategy"
in var/webhook-endpoints.json, sharing the same slug.
SIGNAL_RELAY_KILL=1 in the environment stops every route regardless
of what is written here. One variable, one SSH command.
Keys named _* are ignored, so this comment can stay.
